notes: Multi Studio version 2.2.8: **Duplicate Text Detection & Visual Badges**: Script Studio now automatically detects duplicate paragraphs in your script. A real-time notice warns you below the paste area if pasted text matches existing blocks, and clear duplicate badges appear directly on cards with identical content for easy identification without interrupting your flow., **Dynamic & Color-Coded Language Advisory Tooltips in AI Transcriber**: The language selector now features contextual, color-coded dynamic tooltips (emerald for optimal/supported languages like Thai, amber for advisories like Whisper Khmer limitations, and indigo for auto-detection) displaying model recommendations without taking up vertical panel space., **Automated Clean Uninstallation on Windows (Disk Space Reclaim)**: Added an NSIS uninstaller hook that automatically deletes all downloaded AI models, temporary caches, and local databases when uninstalling on Windows, reclaiming 100% of disk space., **Default Collapsed Blocks on Add**: Newly added and pasted blocks in Script Studio now appear collapsed by default, keeping large scripts compact, clean, and effortless to browse., **Distinct Green Highlight for Completed Blocks**: Marking an audio block as completed highlights the card with a subtle emerald-green border and tinted background for clear visual tracking., **Clean Formatted Time Display**: Replaced raw seconds with formatted time (e.g. `0:15`, `1:23`, or `1:02:15`) on audio segment seekbars, eliminating clutter from raw second counts., **Strict Extension Validation in File Renamer**: Custom extension inputs now strictly disallow spaces and automatically strip whitespace or leading dots to ensure valid, safe file extensions across all operating systems., **Cross-Platform Typography & Windows Font Smoothing**: Configured full font parity across Windows and macOS by linking Next.js Inter (`--font-inter`) with robust system fallbacks (`Segoe UI`, `Kantumruy Pro`, `Leelawadee UI`, `Sarabun`) and enabling hardware font anti-aliasing and subpixel text rendering to ensure clean, crisp typography on both PC and Mac., **Consistent Whisper Model Size Display**: Standardized downloaded Whisper model size calculations to decimal GB matching official manifests, accurately displaying Large-v3 Turbo as `1.6 GB` (rather than rounding down to `1.5 GB` alongside Medium)., **Redundant Thai Speech Advisory Banner**: Removed the bulky Thai speech advisory banner from the AI Transcriber configuration panel, freeing up vertical space and eliminating UI clutter.
